source.verification: gpgv against the GNU keyring: good signature

prerequisites.role: build-time only: linked into the GCC compiler binaries, not into llmpalooza
prerequisites.note: The builds use --disable-nls; all five archives are build-time inputs of the compiler only

gcc.configure: see build-gcc.sh (languages c,c++; no multilib/bootstrap; default PIE; libsanitizer/libgomp/libitm/libssp/libvtv/libquadmath disabled)
gcc.category: D-017 declared platform dependency family (libstdc++ and compiler support runtimes), built from source; GCC's compiler binaries are unused build tools
gcc.license: Primary terms: GPL-3.0-or-later WITH GCC-exception-3.1 for libstdc++, libgcc and libatomic; embedded components and header notices are recorded below
embedded_components: libstdc++.a: Ryu (Apache-2.0 OR BSL-1.0; take BSL-1.0, no object-code notice), linked by floating-point formatting
libstdc++.a: fast_float (MIT in src/c++17/fast_float/fast_float.h; ship MIT notice if linked), linked only by floating-point std::from_chars
libstdc++exp.a: libbacktrace (BSD-3-Clause); only if libstdc++exp.a is linked, which release builds do not
include/c++/16/bits headers, including stl_vector.h and stl_algobase.h: Hewlett-Packard and Silicon Graphics permission notices; retain their copyright and permission text in supporting documentation
include/c++/16/bits/shared_ptr*.h and tr1/shared_ptr.h: Boost-derived code under BSL-1.0; no object-code notice, but redistributed headers retain it

Other installed headers: Jeremy Siek permission notice in bits/boost_concept_check.h; IBM-HRL permission notices in ext/pb_ds/*, ext/typelist.h and ext/throw_allocator.h; retain applicable texts when used or shipped

libgcc.a: glibc soft-fp objects, including addtf3.o on both architectures; LGPL-2.1-or-later with the file-level executable-linking permission in libgcc/soft-fp/*; separate archive distribution retains LGPL obligations
gcc.header_audit: M1 audits the exact used or shipped header set; the embedded-component examples are not an exhaustive header-license inventory
